pin_regs.reason: Source-registered (ot_hdc_v41x_attn_hgrp_s header): every input lands in a flop at the pin (R0 r_iv/r_ibank/r_ib, per-head kept ot_hdc_v41x_kreg copies of ld_*, hh/gsel from gid) and every output is a flop (ov, oy, oflt); recipe pin_regs would add a second unpriced stage on every score / p.v beat.

structural_change: SVC3 10-19: dsdv_svc_rs_attw stalled in synthesis on its engine (4 x ot_hdc_v41x_attn_tile_l, 933k pre-cells each, the SVCQ_ENG_FG3 simulation latencies FPL 3 / FML 3, not 833 ps-safe). The production engine (no FG3) is TILE_S 1: each tile = 4 x ot_hdc_v41x_attn_hgrp_s + wiring. This kit hardens that head group ONCE at the S81 engine parameters as the parameter-free ot_hdc_v41x_attn_hgrp_s81 (H16 HG4 TD32 NBANK5 BW3 PWORDS2 FPL4 FML6 F12 1, PCOLP 1); 16 instances per attw engine (tile_s with -DOT_ATTN_HGRP_HARD). Zero added cycles vs hgrp_s. SVC5 10-19 _ns variant: identical RTL/outline; yosys synth -noshare (SAT resource sharing took 2169 s of the 3539 s synth and stalled the 2700 s gate cap; dedicated operators per lane = no shared-resource muxing, checklist item 4). Parallel fallback to s81svc_attn_hgrp (bind first to close).
